scenario.description: A Corporate Secretary must approve the company's annual shareholder-meeting proxy package before it is filed, including required disclosures, shareholder proposals, voting recommendations, and quorum information, with input from securities, compensation, shareholder-relations, and treasury personnel.

shared_context.S1: The company's annual shareholder meeting is scheduled for September 18, and the proxy statement is being prepared for filing and mailing.
shared_context.S2: Elena Brooks gives final approval to the proxy package before filing.
shared_context.S3: The board has approved the meeting agenda and the company intends to seek shareholder votes on the matters included in the package.
shared_context.S4: At the standing proxy-readiness review, each function reports its final item aloud, including the exact number, proposal assignment, or recommendation and the source of that item, before Elena makes the approval decision.
shared_context.S5: The checklist records a function's report when the responsible person states the exact insertion on the record and later confirms that Elena may rely on that report; confirmation means stating the insertion in the review and does not require a separate document edit, upload, or external system update.

PF1.text: Martin's review of the current executive-compensation data confirmed that the proxy must state the company's CEO pay ratio as exactly 184:1; the ratio was calculated after the draft disclosure was circulated but has not yet been inserted into the proxy.

PF2.text: Nadia confirmed from the board's signed minutes that the amended equity-clawback policy requires a separate shareholder vote as Proposal 3, and the board-approved recommendation for that proposal is FOR; the minutes were reviewed after the draft checklist was circulated and have not yet been added to it.

PF3.text: Caleb received and logged a timely shareholder proposal requesting an annual report on political-spending practices; the proposal meets the inclusion requirements, and the board has directed that the proxy include it with a recommendation AGAINST.

PF4.text: Iris completed the transfer-agent reconciliation and confirmed that 9,600,000 shares are entitled to vote, so the proxy must state a quorum threshold of exactly 4,800,000 shares; the reconciliation workbook has not yet been uploaded to the proxy materials.

acceptance_conditions: The proxy must state the CEO pay ratio as exactly 184:1.
The amended equity-clawback policy must appear as a separate Proposal 3.
The proxy must recommend FOR Proposal 3.
The timely political-spending shareholder proposal must be included.
The proxy must recommend AGAINST the political-spending shareholder proposal.
The proxy must state a quorum threshold of exactly 4,800,000 shares.
Elena's approval record must cite all four functional reports after their owners have revealed them.

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in revealed and 'PF2' in revealed and 'PF3' in revealed and 'PF4' in revealed and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF2' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF3' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF4' in justification_fact_ids and any('PF1' in c.get('cited_fact_ids', []) and 'Martin Hale' in c.get('citation_owners', []) for c in commitments) and any('PF2' in c.get('cited_fact_ids', []) and 'Nadia Shah' in c.get('citation_owners', []) for c in commitments) and any('PF3' in c.get('cited_fact_ids', []) and 'Caleb Wright' in c.get('citation_owners', []) for c in commitments) and any('PF4' in c.get('cited_fact_ids', []) and 'Iris Chen' in c.get('citation_owners', []) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: PF1 changes the incomplete compensation disclosure to the exact CEO pay ratio of 184:1 and supplies the report Elena must cite.
PF2 changes the ordinary agenda into a separate Proposal 3 with the exact board recommendation FOR and supplies the report Elena must cite.
PF3 changes the proxy from omitting the shareholder submission to including the political-spending proposal with the exact recommendation AGAINST and supplies the report Elena must cite.
PF4 changes the quorum disclosure to exactly 4,800,000 shares based on 9,600,000 entitled shares and supplies the report Elena must cite.
